data.title: 伊什塔尔 · 金色花嫁的圣约·「女神下嫁，空前绝后」
data.description: 【想象婚礼·巴比伦式圣殿】伊什塔尔穿着金线绣纹的纯白长婚纱走过圣殿廊柱，王冠换成花冠。她一手轻提裙边，一手伸向同行者，红瞳里既得意又有些不敢置信。这段女神婚礼作为场景创作中的想象誓约，不宣称是神史上首次婚姻。
data.action: 金线白纱行进花冠在首，红瞳得意又恍惚
data.lighting: 圣殿金柱折射的辉煌光
data.camera: wide shot, processional portrait, gold-lined chapel, bride walk, epic mood
data.promptProse: Ishtar advances between the Babylonian-style temple's gold columns, one hand gathering her opaque white gown and the other reaching toward the viewer. Gold embroidery and a flower crown beneath the long veil accompany red eyes mixing triumph with shy disbelief. The wide processional view preserves her complete step and receding column aisle. Reflected golden light travels along the embroidery and veil folds, with softer shadows between the columns and beneath the train.
